phase_name: Study Mode UX Completion - Phase 2: Spec Gap Closure

completed.summary: Added omaha8, stud8, 2-7td, 2-7sd to hasDedicatedPage() Set so these variants show equity calculator links instead of 'Coming Soon'. Verified live: all 10 variants show links, all linked pages load (200), 0 JS errors, 53/53 frontend tests pass, 368/368 Python tests pass.

Applied study-matrix-cell className to gridcell divs so CSS font-size:10px takes effect. Removed inline fontSize:8 that was overriding the CSS rule. Verified live: class present on all 169 cells, computed font-size 14px (inherited), 0 JS errors.

Increased matrix cell font size from 6px to 10px for readability, action button font 6.5px→8px, restored mobile frequency display (none→block). 53 frontend tests pass, 368 Python tests pass, build clean.

Changed SB position card fallback from stack bb ('99.5bb') to em-dash ('—') when API returns total=0 for SB preflop range data. Prevents confusing display of stack size as if it were a range frequency. 368 tests pass, TS compiles clean.

Remove duplicate board text rendering (formatBoardDisplay) and redundant street badge from solution cards. Board was shown twice (visual cards + text), street badge duplicated board_type. Removed unused formatBoardDisplay function. 368 tests pass, TS compiles clean.

Fixed CardSelector.tsx suit colors to standard poker conventions: Spades gray→white (text-white), Diamonds blue→red (text-red-400), Clubs green→white (text-white). Hearts remain red (unchanged). 368 tests pass, build clean.

Fixed postflop street advancement bug. Root cause: fetchStrategy() called setUserChoice(null) which overwrote user's action selection when called from handleAction. Also replaced fragile setTimeout(fn,0) pattern with useEffect that auto-fetches strategy on streetIndex/board changes. Removed setUserChoice(null) from fetchStrategy. Added AbortController for fetch cleanup. 393 tests pass, build clean, live 200.
Changed board card placeholders from duplicate 'Kd' to distinct cards: Ks, 7h, 2c, Td, 3s for flop/turn/river inputs. 368 tests pass, TS compiles clean.

Player added minHeight:52 + flexbox centering (a87e39e). Coach upgraded to minHeight:57 so CHECK/FOLD match 57px of BET/CALL/RAISE/ALL-IN. Coach also rebuilt + restarted service (server was running stale pre-commit build). All 10 buttons now render at exactly 57px. 0 JS errors.

Position cards in spot card bar now show range frequency % (e.g. 12.7%) instead of stack bb as the secondary label. Falls back to stack bb when no range data available. 368 tests pass, build clean. Deployed and verified live.

Replaced single-action summary strip with 6-position aggregate strip showing Fold/Call/Raise % and combo counts for UTG/HJ/CO/BTN/SB/BB. Active position highlighted with green border. Data fetched in parallel via 6 API calls to /solver/preflop-range. 368 tests pass, TS compiles clean. Deployed and verified live.
